claims: The University of Notre Dame is in Indiana.
The University of Notre Dame is a private Catholic research university.
The University of Notre Dame was founded in 1842.
The University of Notre Dame's sports teams are the "Fighting Irish".
The University of Notre Dame has the Golden Dome.
The University of Notre Dame has Notre Dame Stadium.
The University of Notre Dame's women's basketball team recently competed in the 2026 Elite Eight.
The University of Notre Dame has the newly dedicated "Notre Dame Circle" honoring women.
Notre-Dame de Paris Cathedral is situated in Paris.
Notre-Dame de Paris Cathedral is currently under restoration.
Notre-Dame de Paris Cathedral had a major fire in 2019.
The name "Notre Dame" is French for "Our Lady".
"Our Lady" refers to Mary, the mother of Jesus.
